tasks.summary: Permanent fix for Reconstruction failed: Reconstruction has no durable job record for publication.
root_causes: 1. multiviewIdentify/multiviewReconstruct used raw axios (no auth interceptor), stripping Authorization header; effective_user_id resolved to default_user (banned identity)
2. garment_identification_routes.py used allow_guest=True; UnifiedJobState rejected banned identities but exception was swallowed
3. create_job split register_idempotency + create_job across two non-atomic calls; both exceptions swallowed; job enqueued to Redis with no PostgreSQL row; API returned 200 OK
4. _process_job swallowed load_job failure; ran 21s of 3D compute on nonexistent job; crashed only at publication gate
5. retry_job only mutated in-memory _jobs without DB transition; recover_stranded_jobs only scanned in-memory _jobs (empty on restart)

backend/app/services/garments/job_manage: create_job: atomic create_job_atomic BEFORE temp file writes and Redis enqueue; propagates TenantSecurityViolationException and IdempotencyConflictException; raises DurablePersistenceUnavailableError on DB failure; raises QueueEnqueueError on Redis failure with compensate_enqueue_failure rollback; phantom cached job_id fixed to load from persisted COMPLETED DB row

_process_job: mandatory DB presence gate before 3D compute; owner/tenant mismatch check; terminal state skip; atomic CLAIMED/PROCESSING with active_lease_gen; strict VALIDATING/PUBLISHING transitions; fenced publication; commit_completion with lease_gen check; Redis acknowledge; failure closure on job.error
